device.description: 8-bit 20 MSPS semiflash ADC with parallel 3-state outputs and internal reference resistors
device.note: tlc5510.pdf (SLAS095L) p.1 pinout (PW/NS), p.3 terminal functions and recommended operating conditions, p.5 operating characteristics (td(D), ten, tdis) and Figure 1 I/O timing, p.6 functional description (output on CLK rising, 2.5-clock latency, Figure 2), p.8 Table 1 output code

pages: p.1 (pinout, options), p.3 (terminal functions, ROC: VDDD 4.75-5.25 V, VIH 4 V, VIL 1 V, clock pulse 25 ns min), p.5 (td(D) 30 ns max, ten 5 ns, tdis 7 ns, Figure 1), p.6 (functional description, Figure 2), p.8 (Table 1 output code)
notModeled: analog input, reference ladder and the internal reference resistors (REFT/REFTS/REFB/REFBS); the result is always the 0 V code 0x00 (an input at or below Vref(B) reads 00000000, p.8 Table 1)
pipeline latency of 2.5 clocks (sampled on CLK falling, output on the rising edge of the 4th clock, p.6); the code is constant
OE enable / disable times ten 5 ns and tdis 7 ns (typical, p.5) are not timed; OE high puts D1-D8 in high impedance
conversion rate limit 20 MSPS and clock pulse widths 25 ns min (p.3, p.5)
TLC5510A (4 V full scale, external reference across the center divider): same pinout and digital side; its NS parts are listed under this device
variants: TLC5510A shares the datasheet: 4-V full-scale input with an externally applied reference (REFBS to ground, REFTS to VDDA); digital interface identical. TLC5510 is interchangeable with the Sony CXD1175 (p.1).
